method: Checkpoints are scans/**/*.yaml files with a 40-character head; only scanner groundwork-explore@1 is treated as a direct repository scan, imported discovery is separate. Counts are existing model records attributed by direct or inherited sources, not an exhaustive code scan; a shared fact can count for multiple repos. Git availability checked locally with cat-file; no fetch or runtime calls.
